findingsAndResolution: Updated stale enemy-renderer test fixture to include the production loading layer.
Bound each async ready callback to its original world request and battle, preventing old camera/overlay updates.
Blocked actual free-battle commands and keys during art loading; Escape still cancels.
Rejected Kurushima v1 with 9 foreign pixels and Shimazu v1 with 69; regenerated complete silhouettes with spacing. Final v2 passed image/pixel review with 61px and 42px problematic-row gaps.

limits: Movement currently alternates two poses; longer walking and attack sequences remain.
Turtle and courier use 12 runtime poses each; four additional readiness poses are prepared rather than used as attack animation.
Special costumes and menu/flat-mode portraits retain their existing catalogs.
Physical-phone memory, thermal behavior, sustained FPS and touch controls were not verified.
Terrain/path naturalization and per-skill independent effects remain separate art work.
